title: Bememo Bleached Cheesecloth for Straining Extra Large 110 Yard 100% Natural Cotton Grade 50 Cheese Cloth for Wedding Decoration, Polishing, Straining, White (Grade 50,110 x 1 Yard)
description:
Crafted from Cotton Fabric: cheese cloths for cooking are made of cotton fabric material, which is of reliable quality, not easy to tear, deform or fade, can be washed and reusable, also absorbent, suitable for making soy milk, cheese and so on, can serve you for a long time
Long Enough to Use: these cheesecloth for baking measure about 1 yd x 110 yd, lightweight and portable, proper size makes it convenient for meeting your daily use demands
Washable and Easy to Clean: the cheesecloth for straining is washable, you can wash them by hand in the sink, or wash them by machine, please note that keep them away from detergents and fabric softeners, and use only mild detergent if necessary, then rinse thoroughly to remove any soap residue; If you see bits of curd on the cloth, you can remove it by whey or white vinegar, thus saving your time and energy
Package Content: the package will provide you with 1 roll of cheese cloth in white color, it is made of quality material and enjoys a wide range of applications, can well meet your daily use, replacement and sharing needs
Practical for Many Food: the cheesecloth roll is a nice choice for wrapping spices, basting or stuffing poultry, making soft cheeses, squeezing juice, wrapping turkey, chicken when roasting and so on, providing you with a convenient using experience
reviews_5s:
Wow! Huge roll. Used cheesecloth on art projects, wrapped trees to protect fruits from bugs, wrapped horses leg from injury. Great investment. Next use for squeezing blueberries for juice. I never have to spend time searching to buy! This will last for my life for any project!This was/is really good very fine woven cheese cloth, highly recommend.When I make soups I always strain them. Using a colander or strainer seems to allow some cloudiness but if I add cheesecloth to the strainer it's much cleaner stock. This is a nice sized roll of cheesecloth so I can cut it to size which is a nice option.I've never bought cheesecloth before, I've been using some I got from my mom. Hers is ages old, I don't even know. Comparing the two, hers is softer but that's to be expected from normal wear and cleaning.

The mesh spacing seems to be as similar as I can see with my eyes.

I recently started learning how to make cheese from goats. This gives me plenty to experiment with and I still have plenty to put in my preps.

I can't imagine using cheesecloth for a wedding or decorating anything like the listing pix show but hey, maybe that's A Thing, I wouldn't know.
